breakdown.description: The global horizontal traction on the left slope is reinterpreted as slope-aligned tangential shear
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt was contradictory, first stating to apply a horizontal traction, then reinterpreting it as a slope-aligned tangential shear. The ground truth clarifies that the traction should be horizontal. The agent correctly resolved this by explicitly stating to 'Apply a horizontal traction... as a global horizontal load (not tangential shear)', which directly aligns with the ground truth.
